import random, struct
# 200000 /64 prefixes at even keys -> 400001 rows (worst case row count)
with open('fib_max.txt','w') as f:
    for i in range(200000):
        k = 2*i
        w = [(k>>48)&0xffff,(k>>32)&0xffff,(k>>16)&0xffff,k&0xffff,0,0,0,1]
        f.write(":".join("%x"%x for x in w) + "/64 %d\n" % (i % 4294967296))
# 200000 mixed-length prefixes (dense-ish, realistic)
rng = random.Random(99)
seen=set()
with open('fib_mix.txt','w') as f:
    while len(seen) < 200000:
        ln = rng.choice([rng.randrange(1,65), rng.randrange(16,65), rng.randrange(48,65), 64, 32])
        u = rng.getrandbits(64) & (((1<<ln)-1) << (64-ln))
        if (u,ln) in seen: continue
        seen.add((u,ln))
    for (u,ln) in sorted(seen):
        w = [(u>>48)&0xffff,(u>>32)&0xffff,(u>>16)&0xffff,u&0xffff,rng.getrandbits(16),rng.getrandbits(16),rng.getrandbits(16),rng.getrandbits(16)]
        f.write(":".join("%x"%x for x in w) + "/%d %d\n" % (ln, rng.randrange(0,1<<32)))
# 1000000-record trace
with open('trace_max.txt','w') as f:
    for i in range(1000000):
        k = rng.getrandbits(64)
        w = [(k>>48)&0xffff,(k>>32)&0xffff,(k>>16)&0xffff,k&0xffff,rng.getrandbits(16),rng.getrandbits(16),rng.getrandbits(16),rng.getrandbits(16)]
        f.write(":".join("%x"%x for x in w) + "\n")
print("generated")
PYEOF
